sceneFacts.shortVersion: This film challenged stereotypes with its male stylist.
sceneFacts.longDescription: This film challenged stereotypes with its male stylist. He was a fashion-conscious Black man who was not gay, and his decision to date a white woman brought questions but not crisis.
